title: Add a visit to an existing pet from the owner detail page
asserts: Booking through the real form without touching the vet picker still succeeds.
The new row's .visit-vet cell on the owner's page reads exactly "none".
notes: Pre-existing scenario; this branch added the vet assertion to it. It is the only test that walks the unattended path through the UI rather than posting a null vetId at the API.

title: Add a visit attended by a vet
asserts: The vet picker is populated from the running stack's own /api/vets roster, not a stub.
Picking a vet and submitting stores it: the visit comes back with that vet.
The owner's page visit row shows the picked vet's full name in its .visit-vet cell.
notes: The only end-to-end evidence on the branch that the vet link survives the whole round trip. It also covers visit-list.component, whose own spec file this branch never touched - so a regression there is caught here or nowhere. Tagged @generate_sequence: its trace is what draws add-visit.spec.ts.add-a-visit-attended-by-a-vet.genseq.puml.

title: The vet chosen while booking is named everywhere the visit is listed
asserts: A vet picked in the real New Visit form comes back on the owner's page visit row.
The SAME vet is named on /visits, the clinic-wide list — the second screen this branch put a Vet column on, and the only one no test looked at.
notes: Added after the review, and the review is why: the branch it replaced carried a UI Gherkin scenario for this ticket (add-visit.feature, tag test-pr-pre-reimpl-2026-09-17) and the reimplementation dropped it. Written over add-visit.dsl.ts, the same functions add-visit.spec.ts calls, so the two differ only in how they read. Tagged @generate_sequence: its trace draws book-visit-with-vet.feature.*.genseq.puml.

title: A visit nobody attended says so, rather than saying nothing
asserts: Booking with the vet picker untouched leaves the row's .visit-vet cell reading "none" — a statement, not an empty cell.
notes: The optional half of the field: every visit older than V4__visit_vet.sql has no vet.
